This 
 document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed an 
 annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.

The purpose of this converter is 
 making a matching of devices with current output to the normal voltage input 
 of BBC electronic devices. The converter sections are not insulated from one 
 other.

This document 
 initiated by eng. Mahmod Saleh Ali, tested by eng. Maher Abd Elgwad Salem 
 and eng. Mohamed El-Sayed Ahmed, 
 approved by eng. 
 Mohamed Salah Eldin Abd Elghafar general director.

This document 
 revised by eng. Nageh Soliman Shousha: CEPC quality control director, and 
 certified by eng. Afaf Ebrahim El-Dib: CEPC inspection & quality control's 
 Head Sector and MPIS coordinator

A 
work permit must be issued and the qualified 
maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with 
caution marks surrounding the work area.

Wear safety helmet, shoes, breathing-mask, 
safety glasses is required.

work permit must be issued and the qualified 
maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with 
caution marks surrounding the work area.

Wear safety helmet, shoes, breathing-mask, 
safety glasses is required.

Inject at both 
 pressure transmitters (R1286, R1287) direct with pressure supply (Air 
 Compressor).

Increase the 
 pressure from (6.11 bar) to (12.1 bar).

Measure the 
 inject current (4-20 m A) at pin (04) on the transducer.

Measure the 
 output voltage (2-10 V) at pin (07) on the transducer.

Compare 
 characteristic with Final Setting at Measurements as shown in figure (1).

Readjust the 
 (I/U) transducer if necessary (zero at R6 and span at R9).

Tools 
and Equipment
Ammeter (0 - 20A).
Voltmeter(0 -750 volt)
Test leads.
Air Compressor
Pressure gauge indicator (0-15bar)
Work to be carried out
Inject at both 
 pressure transmitters (R1286, R1287) direct with pressure supply (Air 
 Compressor).
Increase the 
 pressure from (6.11 bar) to (12.1 bar).
Measure the 
 inject current (4-20 m A) at pin (04) on the transducer.
Measure the 
 output voltage (2-10 V) at pin (07) on the transducer.
Compare 
 characteristic with Final Setting at Measurements as shown in figure (1).
Readjust the 
 (I/U) transducer if necessary (zero at R6 and span at R9).
